items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: took for granted the kind of life we had under Clinton and Obama

That’s not an empty allegation, we saw that on January 6. And to kind of spy on the enemy I’ve kind of listened to Sean Hannity a couple of times and people like that, and read some things, and they keep…

left.
